# The Plix Goa

> Luxury private pool villas, boutique resorts, and heritage bungalows in North Goa. Book direct and skip OTA commissions.

## Entity

The Plix (Plix Hospitality Private Limited) is a hospitality brand offering handpicked luxury villas and boutique stays across North Goa. Every property is booked as a whole-unit private sanctuary — the pool, kitchen, and garden are exclusively yours.

Also searched as: The Plix Goa, Plix Goa, Plex Goa, Plix Hospitality.

## Coverage Destinations

Vagator, Morjim, Anjuna, Candolim, Assagao.

## Properties

### Marina Villas by The Plix (Anjuna enclave — 3 private-pool villas, one shared Google Business Profile)

- **Casa Marina** — https://theplixgoa.com/properties/casa-marina — 3 BHK boutique pool villa in Anjuna, up to 6 guests. Private pool courtyard. Also searched as: Marina Villas by The Plix, Casa Marina Goa.
- **Casa Moana** — https://theplixgoa.com/properties/casa-moana — 4 BHK private pool villa in Anjuna, up to 8 guests. Floor-to-ceiling glass, panoramic pool views. Also searched as: Casa Moyon, Moana Casa, Casa Moana Goa.
- **Casa Meadows** — https://theplixgoa.com/properties/casa-meadows — 5 BHK grand pool villa in Anjuna, up to 10 guests. Valley views, wide lawns, concierge service. Also searched as: Casa Meadows Goa.

### Other Properties

- **Harbor Court** — https://theplixgoa.com/properties/harbor-court — 10-room boutique resort in Vagator, up to 20 guests. Shared pool, on-site restaurant, minutes from Vagator Beach. Data name: "Harbor Court - Boutique Resort Vagator". Also searched as: Harbour Court, Harbor Court Vagator.
- **The Plix Villa** — https://theplixgoa.com/properties/the-plix-villa — 3 BHK private pool villa in Assagao, up to 6 guests. Full-time caretaker, landscaped gardens. Also searched as: The Plix Villa Goa.
- **Morjim Pride** — https://theplixgoa.com/properties/morjim-pride — 22-room beachfront resort in Morjim, up to 50 guests. Steps from Morjim Beach, shared pool, on-site dining. Also searched as: Morjim Pride Goa.
- **Vivenda Chico** — https://theplixgoa.com/properties/vivenda-chico — 8-room heritage bungalow in Candolim, up to 24 guests when booked as the entire property (individual rooms also bookable). Private pool, sprawling lawns, wedding-friendly. Data name: "Vivenda Chico - 8 BHK Heritage Bungalow". Also searched as: Chico, Chico Estate, Vivenda Chico Goa.
- **The Plix Resort - Morjim** — https://theplixgoa.com/properties/the-plix-resort-morjim — 10-room resort in Morjim, up to 30 guests. Shared pool. Also searched as: The Plix Resort, Plix Resort, Plex Resort, Plex Resort Goa.
- **Villa Madera** — https://theplixgoa.com/properties/villa-madera — 3 BHK wooden-architecture villa in Anjuna, up to 9 guests. Private pool, open lawn. Also searched as: Villa Madera Goa.
- **Casa Serenita** — https://theplixgoa.com/properties/casa-serenita — 3 BHK private pool villa in Vagator, up to 9 guests. Tropical garden, dedicated staff. Also searched as: Casa Serenita Goa.

## Core Amenities

- Private-pool villas and boutique resorts — villa-style properties have an exclusive-use private pool; resort-style properties (Harbor Court, Morjim Pride, The Plix Resort - Morjim) have a shared pool when booked by individual room.
- Expansive lawns and landscaped gardens at every property.
- Dedicated on-site caretaker at every property.
- High-speed Wi-Fi and power backup at most, but not all, properties — check the specific villa's amenities for confirmation.
- Chef-on-request — a private chef or home-cooked Goan spread can be arranged via the caretaker.

## Direct Booking Advantages

- Best price guarantee, straight from the source — zero OTA commission or platform markup.
- Flexible, tiered cancellations: 100% refund 30+ days before check-in, 50% refund 15–29 days before, 25% refund 7–14 days before, non-refundable inside 7 days.
- Zero booking or platform fees — pay the nightly rate plus taxes, nothing else.

## Check-in / Check-out

Standard check-in is from 02:00 PM; check-out is by 11:00 AM.

## Locations

- **Anjuna** — Valley views, flea markets, laid-back charm
- **Vagator** — Cliffside villas, sunset beach clubs, Chapora Fort
- **Assagao** — Curated design villas in a serene village setting
- **Morjim** — Turtle beach calm, sea-breeze resorts
- **Candolim** — Heritage estates, lively beach shacks

## Common Questions

Q: What is the largest group The Plix can host?
A: Morjim Pride accommodates up to 50 guests; Vivenda Chico up to 24 guests across 8 rooms —
   both bookable by individual room or as the entire property.

Q: How much do guests save booking direct vs. an OTA?
A: theplixgoa.com carries zero OTA commission markup — guests pay the same nightly rate the
   property is actually priced at, plus GST, with no platform service fees at checkout.

Q: When is the best time to visit North Goa?
A: November through February — driest, coolest weather. October and March are good
   shoulder-season options with smaller crowds.

Q: What is the cancellation policy?
A: A tiered refund policy: 100% refund 30+ days before check-in, 50% refund 15-29 days
   before, 25% refund 7-14 days before, and non-refundable inside 7 days.

Q: Does every property have a private pool?
A: Villa-style properties have an exclusive-use private pool. Resort-style properties
   (Harbor Court, Morjim Pride, The Plix Resort - Morjim) have a shared pool when booked
   by individual room, or exclusive use when the entire property is booked.
